designDecisionsAndRationale: Shared SQLite transaction arbitration remains request-first blocks ordinary terminal commit and terminal-first rejects late cancellation without changing the winner.

Trace initial terminal candidate, hook error, later saves, observer join and cancellation observation because a one-shot throw only blocks one write and does not prove a nonterminal injection boundary.
Repair only the demonstrated seam and establish selected-host stop proof before joined cancellation persistence; uncertain stop stays fenced.
intentionalTradeoffs: Conditional edits to existing seams and minimal test-only instrumentation avoid a general hook framework.
A failed broad aggregate remains visible and separately classified; historical non-slice failures do not become a passing gate.
